_comment: Official vendor Streamable HTTP MCP endpoints. Gateway secret is MCP_TOKEN_<DEPT>_<ID>. Run node scripts/list-mcp-tools.mjs to draft overrides from a live tools/list. URLs are unconfirmed until that call returns tools. Tenant Salesforce: https://api.salesforce.com/platform/mcp/v1/d/{mydomain}/platform/sobject-all.

github.description: Source code, issues and pull requests

jira.description: Issue and project tracking (Atlassian Jira / Confluence)

google-drive.description: Google Drive (Claude Drive connector host). OAuth; gateway uses a department service credential, not the end user.

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare account resources (Code Mode API MCP)

warehouse.description: Snowflake-managed Cortex MCP. Replace org-account / ANALYTICS / PUBLIC / agents with your account URL, database, schema and MCP server name.

salesforce.description: Sales CRM (Salesforce hosted SObject All). Swap in the org My Domain URL if required.

vuln-scanner.description: Snyk Evo hosted MCP (AI inventory, risk, policy). Code scanning remains the local Snyk CLI MCP.

contract-mgmt.description: Contract lifecycle (DocuSign hosted MCP if enabled on the account)
